title: Reviewer Findings Output
description: The model-facing output schema for the reviewer findings call. Does not include a verdict field; that is determined by code.

findings.description: List of code issues found by the reviewer

path.description: File path where the issue was found; empty string for unanchored prior comments

line.description: New-side line number in the diff; 0 for unanchored prior comments

problem.description: What is wrong with the code

why_blocking.description: Why this problem must be fixed before approval

evidence.description: The offending line or code snippet from the diff or surveyed output

dispositions.description: How each prior comment was handled

prior_comment_id.description: ID of the comment from relay_feedback

linked_finding_index.description: Index into findings array if status is not_fixed and a finding addresses it; null otherwise
